description: Creates a list and returns its edit link and share link; a repeat of the same call by an account with read-and-change access returns the list it already made instead (see again). Optionally with a title, unit, trip dates, a trail link and rows, grouped into folders; a row with items nested under it is a group (stakes under a tent, snacks under a day). Keep the edit link: it is the only way to change a list that isn't filed under an account. With read-and-change access to an account the list is filed under it too, and saved_to_account says whether it was; otherwise the list belongs to whoever holds the edit link, as every list does.

again.description: True to make the same list twice on purpose; otherwise an identical call within ten minutes is a retry (repeated).

folders.description: Folders in order, each with its default classification. Rows go in items, each naming its folder; a folder named only by a row is made after these, as base.

classification.description: What rows in this folder count as unless they say otherwise. Default base.

name.description: The folder's name, unique in the list: Shelter, Clothing, Food.

items.description: The list's rows, in order; each names its folder, or is left in none.

catalog_id.description: A catalog row id from search_catalog. The row takes the catalog's cited weight unless weight_g is given (then yours is kept), its brand, variant and gear type where you leave them out, and follows catalog corrections; give the catalog's own product name as name to follow its name too, since a different one is kept as yours.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable. Omit to follow the folder's default.

folder.description: The folder to put it in, by name. Created when the list has no folder of that name; Unfiled, get_list's name for rows in no folder, leaves it in none.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

items.description: Rows nested under this one, making it a group: stakes under a tent, snacks under a day. One level deep; a nested row is in its parent's folder.

catalog_id.description: A catalog row id from search_catalog. The row takes the catalog's cited weight unless weight_g is given (then yours is kept), its brand, variant and gear type where you leave them out, and follows catalog corrections; give the catalog's own product name as name to follow its name too, since a different one is kept as yours.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable. Omit to follow the folder's default.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

name.description: The product or item name. Required.

needs_cooking.description: Food to cook on this trip. Each unit assumes one boil for a rough fuel estimate; no quantity or weight changes.

note.description: A short free-text note on the row.

variant.description: Size, length or configuration that changes the weight, such as Long or 20F.

volume_l.description: Water only (a name ending in water), in place of qty and weight_g: its whole volume in litres, 1 kg each.

weight_g.description: Weight of ONE unit, in grams. Omit when unknown; the list keeps working without it, and a row with a catalog_id takes the catalog's cited weight.

worn_qty.description: Of qty, how many are worn rather than carried (three pairs of socks, one on your feet). For a row that is entirely worn, set classification to worn instead.

note.description: A short free-text note on the row.

title.description: The list's name, such as the trip or the trail. "Untitled list" when left out.

trail_distance_km.description: The trail's length in kilometres; the list shows distances in km.

trail_label.description: What to call the trail, when the link's own name won't do.

trail_url.description: An http(s) link to the route or trail page.

unit.description: The unit the list displays in. Weights are in grams regardless.

name: create_list

account_note.description: Only when the connector sent an access token and the list still could not be filed under its account: the reason, and what to do instead.

edit_link.description: The write capability. Keep it; it is the only way to change a list that isn't filed under an account. Left out only on a repeat: the server keeps no copy of a link to hand back.

repeated.description: True when this call repeated one the same account made in the last ten minutes: no second list was made, and this is the first one, filed under the account, so edit_list takes its share_code. Pass again: true to make another.

saved_to_account.description: True when the connector's read-and-change access filed the list under its account, where the owner sees it on every device they sign in on.

share_link.description: The read capability, safe to pass on.

totals.description: Whole grams, summed over every row of the list.

carried_g.description: base_g plus consumable_g: what is on your back.

kcal.description: Only when a food row carries calories.

unweighed.description: Only when some rows have no weight yet: how many (the rows marked unweighed), each counted as 0 g above.
